body.description: a close top-down view from high above of the far edge of a Roman colosseum arena, seen from the sand, at the scale of a person: packed ochre sand with a few small rocks fills the lower half of the image; across the upper half the massive curved stone arena wall, built of large cut blocks in visible courses, its face turned toward the viewer; in the middle of the wall a monumental arched gate, its arch about a third of the image's height, framed by heavy stone pilasters and an entablature; directly above the gate, on top of the wall, the emperor's balcony under a red canopy with columns; rows of stone stands rise behind the wall to the top edge; detailed, crisp pixel art at a fine scale; no people, no lettering; the same style as the reference
